protocol.scope: simulation geometry calibration; no real camera/robot calibration
protocol.oracle: independent SAT box collision, stop poses sampled at 0.04 s
protocol.sensor: analytic metric RGB-D depth and planar LiDAR; MuJoCo cross-check

extrinsics.unestimated: camera intrinsics and body dimensions are known fixture inputs; planar LiDAR height must be measured separately

calibration.interpretation: No return is unknown, not free space. Memory requires earlier visibility and reliable short-term odometry.

stop: 前方雷达太近就刹车，沿用先验路线，不根据新障碍绕行。
lidar: 雷达观测更新通行图，并检查整台车刹停时扫过的空间；平面雷达有高度盲区。
depth: 再加入相机米制深度及近期观测，发现低矮和悬空障碍；不使用 RGB 外观定位。

protocol.localization: exact wheel odometry diagnostic; zero bias/slip
protocol.depth: 80x60 pinhole ray-depth, metric optical-axis; no RGB appearance localization
protocol.environment: static introduced obstacles absent from prior; no dynamic clearing
protocol.collision: box SAT, motion samples <=1cm corner travel; oracle only scores

protocol.repair: offline scan-derived constant translation/rotation scale correction
protocol.query: independent closed-loop traversal; frozen map; each arm plans on its own map
protocol.controller: lesson66 fixed planner/tracker/front stop; not lesson67 depth avoidance
